description_en: Queries a list of versions of files to be deployed
description_zh: 获取待发布的文件版本列表
name: ListDeploymentPackageFiles

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The workflow ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173945.html operation to query the workflow ID by name
parameters.help_zh: 业务流程的ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173945.html接口，根据名称查询对应业务流程的ID
parameters.name: business_id

parameters.help_en: The start date for committing. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format
parameters.name: commit_from

parameters.help_en: The end date (included) for committing. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format
parameters.help_zh: 提交截止日期（包含），格式yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: commit_to

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who commits the file
parameters.name: commit_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the code for the file.

The code for files varies based on the file type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212428.html operation to query the type of the code for the file
parameters.help_zh:
文件的代码类型。

不同文件类型其代码不同，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html。
您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212428.html接口，查询文件的代码类型
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.help_en:
The change type. Valid values:

0: addition

1: update

2: deletion
parameters.help_zh:
变更类型 
0：新增
1：更新
2：删除
parameters.name: change_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the files to be queried
parameters.name: file_ids

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size
